content.title: Black Ops Royale Release Time and Details - Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 Guide - IGN
content.text: Black Ops Royale is the new mode added to Warzone acting as a Blackout-inspired Battle Royale mode, free for all players. But what can you expect, and when does it release? This page acts as a comprehensive breakdown of Black Ops Royale, including its release date.Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II & Warzone 2.0 All Launch Details ExplainedadvertisementBlack Ops Royale Release DateBlack Ops Royale releases into Warzone on March 12, 2026 at 9:00PM PT.Black Ops Royale DetailsFramed as "the next evolution of Call of Duty: Warzone", Black Ops Royale sees you exploring the large-scale Avalon map (Endgame from Black Ops 7). The map has received updates to support both Black Ops Royale and Battle Royale. The details of Black Ops Royale matches are as follows: advertisementMap: AvalonSquad Size: QuadsPlayer Count: 100Match Time: 20 - 25 MinutesUnlike other Warzone BR modes, Black Ops Royale has no Loadouts. Deploy into the map with a pistol and a Wingsuit, and scavenge for gear with your squad. There are no Buy Stations, no Gulag, no in-game cash to accumulate and spend.You'll have a total of 2 chances to redeploy; use a scavenged Redeploy Token, or be resurrected by your teammates via a Redeployment Tower. advertisementThere are 5 main, color-coded rarity values to a weapon. The rarer the weapon, the more predetermined Attachments there are on the weapon: Common (Grey): One Attachment.Uncommon (Green): Two Attachments.Rare (Blue): Three Attachments.Epic (Purple): Four Attachments.Legendary (Orange): Five Attachments (maximum for normally secured weapons).advertisementThese groupings of attachments fits into things known as Weapon Build Archetypes. These tailor your collected loot into specific playstyles, so you can be on the lookout for weaponry with attachments (and thus Archetypes) that fit your preferred way of play. For a full list of Weapon Archetypes per weapon type, check out out Weapon Archetypes section of the S2 Reloaded Patch Notes page. Weapon Attachment Kits are new ground loot, but also found within Supply Boxes, or as Activity rewards are Attachment Kits: Attachment Kits automatically increase the Rarity and add the next Attachment to the weapon.The more Attachment Kits you find, the more potent the weapon becomes as the rarity level increases, and more Attachments are automatically unlocked for it.If you see an Attachment Kit, grab it while holding the gun you wish to upgrade (which can include your Infil pistol); the Kit immediately adds an Attachment to the weapon you are carrying, and adds a Rarity level to it.To fully max out a weapon, secure as many Attachment Kits as you need to allow all five of a weapon’s predetermined Attachments to be used.advertisementGlobal Weapon Class BenefitsEach Weapon Class has a set of Class bonuses applied to it at Uncommon (Green) Rarity. These stack as you upgrade your chosen weapon to a higher rarity. The details are as follows: Key:“+” = Very Minor benefit (around 5%)“++” = Minor benefit (around 10%)“+++” = Moderate benefit (around 15%)Assault Rifles: Global Benefits (at Uncommon Rarity)++% Horizontal & Vertical Recoil Control++% Faster Reload SpeedSubmachine Guns: Global Benefits (at Uncommon Rarity)++% Horizontal & Vertical Recoil Control++% Faster Reload SpeedShotguns: Global Benefits (at Uncommon Rarity)+% Better Hipfire Spread+% Better ADS Spread++% Faster Reload SpeedLight Machineguns: Global Benefits (at Uncommon Rarity)++% Horizontal & Vertical Recoil Control++% Faster Reload SpeedMarksman Rifles: Global Benefits (at Uncommon Rarity)++% Horizontal & Vertical Recoil Control++% Faster Reload Speed++% Improved Aiming Idle SwaySniper Rifles: Global Benefits (at Uncommon Rarity)+% Faster Rechambering Speed++% Improved Aiming Idle Sway+++% Improved Flinch ResistancePistols: Global Benefits (at Uncommon Rarity)(Usually the Jäger 45 you are equipped with at Infil)++% Faster Reload SpeedadvertisementTactical EquipmentEMP Grenade: Disables or destroys electronics. Effective against Equipment, Killstreaks, and enemy players. Uncommon loot.Flashbang: Blinds and deafens targets temporarily. Common loot.Grappling Hook: Hook onto buildings and even moving vehicles or the RC-XD Killstreak, and disconnect to drop into a Wingsuit glide. Uncommon loot.Psych Grenade: Explodes on impact, releasing a lingering cloud of hallucinogenic gas. Common loot.Sensor Dart: Lob out the sensor dart projectile and look for a radar ping where it lands, showing enemies in the vicinity. Rare loot.Smoke Grenade: Deploys a smoke screen that blocks vision and automated targeting systems. Common loot.Stim Shot: Military stimulant that quickly heals combat wounds. Common loot.Stun Grenade: Slows victim’s movement and aiming. Common loot.Lethal EquipmentCluster Grenade: Device that scatters smaller explosives when detonated. Uncommon loot.Combat Axe: Thrown axe that can kill enemies in one hit. Bounces off surfaces. Uncommon loot.Cymbal Monkey: Causes a distracting sound that can lure nearby zombies. It explodes after a short countdown. Rare loot within Cradle Breaches.Frag Grenade: Cookable fragmentation grenade. Common loot.Needle Drone: Small flying drone that explodes on impact. Toggles between auto or manual control. Rare loot.Point Turret: Small deployable sentry turret that automatically shoots at enemies, distracting and damaging them. Rare loot.Sticky Grenade: Timed sticky grenade. Common loot.advertisementField UpgradesArmor Box: A blue box that allows you to restock the Armor Plates for you and your team. Common loot.Bubble Shield: A defensive item that deploys a large, domed Bubble Shield that absorbs incoming ranged and explosive damage from all directions until it has sustained enough damage and disintegrates. Rare loot.Deployable Cover: A ballistic shield barricade you can place onto the ground and use as cover or to mount your weapon onto. Common loot.Echo Unit: Creates a stationary facsimile of the player to act as a distraction. Destroyed by shooting at the base of the hologram. Common loot.Munitions Box: An olive color box for restocking equipment to both you and your squad when placed on the ground, refilling your Primary, Secondary, Tacticals, and Lethals. Uncommon loot.Trauma Kit: Trauma Kits are extremely beneficial as they allow you to regain full health as well as bonus health after a three-second usage. Uncommon loot.Trophy System: Place on the ground or the flat surface of a vehicle, and the system destroys incoming enemy projectiles. Common loot.KillstreaksD.A.W.G.: Deployable Armored Weaponized Groundcraft featuring a large caliber turret and rocket pod. Very effective against infantry targets. This mobile quadrupedal turret that follows you, firing on enemies.Deadeye Drone: Remote piloted aerial drone equipped with small caliber sniper rifle and limited ammunition. This remote armament can be controlled by the player.Death Machine: Heavy minigun with a fast fire rate, high penetration, and a large ammunition capacity.Hand Cannon: Powerful large caliber handgun with high bullet damage and penetration.HKDs: Aerial payload delivers wheeled Hunter Killer Drones which seek targets and explode.Psych Bomb: A powerful cluster strike is called delivering a neurotoxic gas cloud at its impact sites.RC-XD: Deploy a small remote-controlled, remote detonated explosive vehicle.War Machine: Powerful burst-fire grenade launcher with projectiles that explode on impact. Large magazine.advertisementVehiclesATVA fast and agile quad built for quick rotations.1 Driver, 1 PassengerLight HeliA mobile helicopter capable of rapid repositioning across the map.1 Driver, 4 PassengersCargo TruckA slow but durable transport vehicle with heavy armor.1 Driver, 1 PassengerDirt BikeA nimble single-rider designed for fast traversal.1 DriverRHIBA boat designed for navigating rivers and coastal areas.1 Driver, 3 PassengersLTVAn armored tactical vehicle with strong durability.1 Driver, 3 PassengersUTVThe Polaris RZR Pro R 4 is a balanced off-road vehicle that offers good speed and handling.1 Driver, 3 PassengersTAVA lightweight vehicle built for speed and repositioning.1 Driver, 1 PassengerFull DetailsFor full details on the Black Ops Royale mode, you can check out the dedicated post on the official Call of Duty website, as well as the Warzone S2 Reloaded Patch Notes page on this wiki.
